texts.label: text
texts.orig: Early C19. 3 storeus, 5 windows. Stuccoed. Modern shop fronts. No 2 a lower frontage; windows in moulded architrave surrounds, eaves bracket cornice and slate roof. Nos 3 and 4 have a string course, cornice, parapet and thier 1st floor windows in round-headed arcading with architraves over on bracket. Over shop front to No.2, flat wooden hood supported on cur shaped brackets; low wrought iton balustrade over.
